library(tidyverse)
library(maps)


attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")


world <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(region))

country_attacks <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

world |>
  left_join(country_attacks, by = c("region" = "Country_lower")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Shark attacks",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_void()
